entrada.texto:
computer resources. The edge servers, in turn, execute the tasks, download and install the necessary container 
images, and report the outcomes to the management. Each user is affiliated with an authorized network, which 
responds to computed models. The job computation results, and user-identifying data are securely stored on the 
blockchain, ensuring the highest level of security and protection.
All approved user identification data is managed by the gateway and uploaded to the blockchain, which 
is continuously updated. The blockchain’s data is readily accessible upon receiving a query response from the 
management. In this setup, users can enjoy the benefits of minimal latency, straightforward implementation, 
and control over an edge computing service. The blockchain, with its robust security and reputation protection, 
ensures the service’s integrity. User clients and associated IoT devices seamlessly register in the blockchain 
system during the setup phase. This process is crucial for enabling user and device re-authentication. User and 
device registration are the final stages of the registration process, which is designed to be user-friendly and 
straightforward.
Main components
1) The manager is responsible for collecting data, task separation, subtask coordination, interim outcome 
conservation, user authentication, and resource handling. In contrast to conventional decentralized edge 
computing designs, the proposed architecture securely encrypts the system using blockchain technology and 
controls the entire system worldwide.
2) The processes are distributed across edge servers. They listen to the work demands and provide the 
management with resource data. Upon receiving user tasks, it will obtain and launch the necessary container 
pictures and establish ports for interaction. The manager will arrange for edge servers to process the job and 
provide the results after receiving the raw data. Since the edge servers are arranged as a changing system, they 
may be quickly added to and deleted from the platform. As a result, edge computing platforms’ expansion and 
reliability are assured.
3) Industry: Every user has an associated IIoT. In response to the relevant user, the industry will act according 
to the directions given by the manager. The edge servers’ calculations are used to determine the instructions. 
Specific data are synced to the blockchain for investigation or additional authentication.
4) First, a system administrator creates a new, distinct ID for each client. The admin then submits this ID as 
an activity request to the blockchain nodes. Using a smart contract, the blockchain node verifies the ID’s presence 
in the system. If the ID is not in use, the transaction is permitted. A new block is created and disseminated to 
all the blockchain nodes. The blockchain uses its private key, a crucial security measure, to generate a user ID 
certificate. This certificate is given to the administrator if the user has properly registered. Administrators can use 
their private keys to access certificate data.
5) Sensors and actuators are found in the suggested design’s physical layer. The data from the sensor or 
actuator is preprocessed as needed, and then the virtual machine, acting as a data handler, forwards it to a tiny 
node in the blockchain application layer. The portable node processes the device registration demand and sends 
an extra transaction request to the blockchain node. In the blockchain network, an intelligent contract confirms 
the device ID. A fresh block is created and dispersed across all nodes on the blockchain after the PoAh procedure 
is finished.

resposta.resumo: O artigo propõe uma arquitetura que combina computação de borda com blockchain para IIoT, onde servidores de borda executam tarefas em containers, armazenam dados de identificação de usuários e dispositivos na blockchain e utilizam contratos inteligentes para registrar e autenticar IDs, proporcionando baixa latência, expansão dinâmica e controle de integridade.

resposta.interpretacao: O texto detalha como a blockchain funciona como camada de confiança para registro, autenticação e certificação de usuários e dispositivos, enquanto a computação de borda fornece processamento próximo ao dado, reduzindo latência. A arquitetura permite escalabilidade dinâmica dos servidores de borda e utiliza contratos inteligentes para validar identidades, reforçando a integridade e a reputação do serviço.
